entities.name: Dante Alighieri
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Italian poet (1265–1321) who wrote the Divine Comedy, considered the greatest work of Italian literature and one of the pinnacles of world literature. It established Italian as a literary language and vividly depicted medieval cosmology.
